Name: WU-Marlon and Gil for Stardew Valley Expanded
Author: xiaowugogo
Description:
本mod，需要搭配Portraiture和Stardew Valley Expanded。

（马龙Marlon 行走图）OverworldSprites在这替换
Mods\Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\assets\CharacterFiles\OverworldSprites\Marlon

CP文件会帮助你更改吉尔的像素小人，如果你装了冲突的美化，可能会出现贴图与本mod的宣传图不符。

（高清肖像）
需要999尾号mod，在mods\Portraiture\Portraits里新建英文或者数字名的文件夹，然后把头像放入，游戏内按p查看，o是锁定（如果你没改快捷键的话）
其中MarlonFay是为RRRR服务的图片名

------------以下为机翻
This mod requires the combination of Portrait and Stardew Valley Expanded.
(Marlon walking picture) Overworld Sprites replaced here
Mods\Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\assets\CharacterFiles\OverworldSprites\Marlon

The CP file will help you change Jill's pixel avatar. If you install conflicting beautification, there may be textures that do not match the promotional image of this mod.

(High definition portrait)
You need a mod ending in 999. Create a new folder with an English or numeric name in mods \ Portraiture \ Portraits, then put your avatar in it. Press p to view it in the game, and o to lock it (if you haven't changed the shortcut key),
MarlonFay is the image name serving RRRR
